response.sql: WITH acc AS (SELECT t.account_id, AVG(t.amount) AS acc_avg FROM trans t GROUP BY t.account_id), reg AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(acc.acc_avg) AS region_avg FROM acc JOIN account a ON a.account_id = acc.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(region_avg) AS all_avg FROM reg) SELECT reg.region, reg.region_avg AS figure, reg.region_avg - overall.all_avg AS excess_over_average, reg.region_avg / overall.all_avg AS ratio_to_average FROM reg CROSS JOIN overall WHERE reg.region_avg > overall.all_avg
